summary: PDS Biotechnology Corp filed an 8-K solely to announce the scheduling of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders for August 10, 2026, and to set a Rule 14a-8 stockholder proposal deadline of June 25, 2026 due to the meeting date being more than 30 days from the prior year's anniversary. This is a routine procedural notice regarding meeting logistics and proxy deadlines, not a special situation. There are no deal terms, no strategic event, and no board change. The filing contains no acquisitions, divestitures, activism, or other corporate event requiring risk-arb analysis.
